entries.shortAnswerEn: Tap Sit with Yin on the home seat. Pick how long — Focus sittings start at 10 minutes. If How Shall We Sit? appears, choose a way, then Begin. A shorter pause is Breath practice, not Sit.
Open More (⋯) or the bottom drawer. In Practice, tap Ground exercise (above Five Moments). Choose Feel the Ground or Look Around. Yin only points here and does not read the steps aloud.

For a file on this device: More (⋯) or the drawer → Backup & restore (Preferences). For optional cloud snapshot of the practice trail: Journey log → bind email. Yin only points; Yin does not back up for you.

The bar at the top left is Today's shared sitting — how long you have sat today, with a quiet ~25 minute soft aim. The product does not label that bar「一炷香」. 「一炷香」is an internal / design name for that light daily sit; the old end-of-sit incense animation is not on the live completion path.

Tap Close on the Confide card, or Cancel if you have not sent. Esc closes the top overlay first. There is no voice command to exit. Yin does not judge why you stop. While you Sit, the local model unloads so sitting can stay smooth.
While you are sitting, the main button at the bottom says Rise. Tap it to end this sit. You can start again anytime with Sit with Yin.

After you tap Sit with Yin, How Shall We Sit? may appear. Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice → How Shall We Sit? if you need it again. Pick Here & Now, Offline Space, or Flow State, then tap Begin.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice → Confide to Yin. On a wide desktop screen there is also a listening ear shortcut. Type a few words and tap Share. Nothing leaves this device on desktop; in a browser, on-device generation is not available — Yin still listens with short, quiet lines where the product allows.
Sit with Yin is for a Focus sit — durations start at 10 minutes. For a shorter pause, use Breath practice on the left orb: a soft sit with Yin, not a full Focus session.

how can I take a breath

entries.shortAnswerEn: Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice → Journey log to see your practice trail on this device. In Confide you can also ask how long you have practiced — Yin reads what is written down here, not a second ledger.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice → Presence moments. These are small check-ins saved on this device. In Confide you can ask what your mood has looked like recently — Yin summarizes what is written here, not a diagnosis.
Open Confide to Yin, then tap What Yin remembers inside the card. You can forget any row there. Saying「Show me what you remember」in Confide lists a short summary — the full list is in that panel.

Backup & restore exports a plain JSON file on this device — not encrypted. You can move it yourself; treat it like private data. Scope includes practice records, presence check-ins, reflections, Yin memory, and preferences — not ambient music uploads.
On desktop, the local companion model unloads while you Sit so focusing can stay smooth. Finish or Rise first, then open Confide again if you need to talk.

On-device Local AI runs in the Samatia desktop app on Mac or Windows — not in this browser. You can still practice and open Confide where the product allows; short quiet lines may appear, but browser-side model download and generation are not shipped.
Sit or breathe with Yin to earn more focus coins — longer, more consistent practice earns more. There is a quiet daily pause so you need not binge. Look under Yin's Collections.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice → The 5 Moments. On a wide screen you can also tap the right orb — Five moments with Yin. The compass shows Arrive → Focus → Recover → Transition → Reflect. Tap a moment to jump to that surface — for example Reflect opens Journey log. Yin only points; this is not a second timer.

entries.factKeyEn: Where do I open Honesty Check-in to record quiet time I already did elsewhere?
entries.shortAnswerEn: Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice → Honesty Check-in — below The 5 Moments. Pick how long your quiet time elsewhere was, take one syncing breath, then Yin records it. This is optional; Sit with Yin still works without it. After check-in you may see a gentle bridge asking if you want to sit now too.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Inspiration → A Quiet Line. One quiet line is chosen locally for today and stays the same until tomorrow. Tap Save image to keep a postcard on your device — no account needed. Yin only points; open the card to read today's words.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Inspiration → Mindful Theater. Yin offers a few curated short visual meditations — pick one and tap Watch on YouTube to open it in your browser (not inside the app). Yin only points; this is a small gift when you have a quiet minute.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Inspiration → Wallpapers. Yin offers a few quiet still frames from her day — pick one and tap Save image to keep it on your device (lock screen or desktop). No account, tip, or Pass needed. Yin only points; this is a free gift.

Grounding is a simple name for noticing what you can see, hear, or feel in the present moment, so attention can rest with the body and the room instead of racing ahead in thought. Many people find that kind of present-moment noticing helpful for everyday calm and focus. It is a general wellness idea, not a medical treatment. Reading this is enough; you do not need to follow any steps here. If you want the in-app exercise, Yin only points to Ground exercise and does not read the steps aloud.

Mindfulness is a general wellness word for noticing what is happening right now — thoughts, feelings, and body sensations — with a bit of openness instead of fighting or judging every moment. Many people find that kind of gentle awareness helpful for everyday stress and focus. It is not a medical treatment. Reading this is enough; you do not need to follow any steps here.

entries.factKeyEn: Are focus practice, meditation, and mindfulness the same thing, or is Sit with Yin a Focus sit rather than a generic meditation class?
entries.shortAnswerEn: In everyday language, meditation is a broad umbrella for many quiet practices. Focus practice usually means keeping attention on one chosen object for a while. Mindfulness often names open, non-judging awareness of the present moment. The words overlap, but they are not identical. In Samatia, Sit with Yin is this product's quiet sit with Yin — no voice guidance. A separate Guided meditation lesson in More → Practice has voice and picture when you want to follow along. Sit with Yin stays a quiet sit. Shorter pauses use Breath practice on the left orb; see KB-FUNC-0011 for how that differs from Sit. Yin explains the words only; Yin does not coach breathing or guide steps here. Reading this is enough; nothing here to follow along with.
keywords: 专注和冥想有什么区别
正念和专注是一回事吗

entries.shortAnswerEn: This is a concept-to-entry map only — Yin repeats the approved FUNC short answers for paths, never reads exercise scripts aloud. Focus / sitting with Yin → main button Sit with Yin (KB-FUNC-0001). A shorter breath pause → left orb Breath practice (KB-FUNC-0011; inventory detail KB-FUNC-0006). Grounding as a practice → Ground exercise (KB-FUNC-0002). Reading this map is enough; for exact taps Yin points to those entries, not a second menu manual.

entries.shortAnswerEn: Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Rituals → Morning Ritual. This is one of Yin's advanced guided scenes — it unlocks with Yin Membership or Sanctuary Lifetime. If it is still locked, the menu shows Available with subscription. Yin walks you through a short morning check-in with chip choices; she only points here and does not read the steps aloud.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Rituals → Emotional Reset — or tap Recover on The 5 Moments compass when unlocked. This advanced scene unlocks with Yin Membership or Sanctuary Lifetime. Yin sits with what feels heavy through chip choices and a longer breath — no fixing, just company. She only points here and does not read the steps aloud.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Rituals → Work Transition. This advanced scene unlocks with Yin Membership or Sanctuary Lifetime. Yin helps you mark what can stay at work and what you bring home — chip choices, not a lecture. She only points here and does not read the steps aloud.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → You are not alone → Quiet together worldwide. While you sit, a shared lantern count can show how many people are quietly with Yin — anonymous, no chat, no account. It is on by default; you can turn it off anytime in Privacy. Sitting with Yin still works either way. Yin only points here and does not read presence numbers aloud.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → You are not alone → My circle. Up to eight people can share a quiet circle — invite someone with a six-character code outside the app. No chat, no account, and no names in this first version. It is optional; Sit with Yin works without it. Yin only points here and does not read circle codes aloud.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Preferences → Choose today's direction again. You can also tap the Today ball on the home screen. It reopens four quiet choices: Focus for a bit, Quiet down, Study or work, or Just looking around. Sitting with Yin still works if you skip it. Yin only points here and does not choose for you.
keywords: What would you like to do today

entries.shortAnswerEn: Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice & moments → Navigate sanctuary. On a wide home screen you can also tap the compass ball. It opens Home, Calendar, and Collection — a way around the sanctuary, not a new practice. Yin only points here.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → You are not alone → Join our community. That opens the public community page in a new tab. It is optional; sitting with Yin does not require joining. Yin only points here and does not read invite links aloud.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Preferences → Subscription. That row opens the membership card. Locked ritual rows also open the same card. Membership is optional and can be canceled anytime — it opens the same advanced rituals and ambience as Sanctuary Lifetime. A tea tip does not unlock those. Sit with Yin works without it. Yin only points here and does not read prices aloud.

Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Preferences → When should I remind you. Turn on Remind me and pick a daily time. If you have not practiced yet that day, a gentle note appears at the top of the page — not a browser notification. This menu row only appears when reminders are available on your device. Yin only points here.

A pomodoro here is a 25-minute Sit with Yin. Tap Sit with Yin, then choose 25 minutes. It does not start a short-break cycle. When the duration microphone is available, you can also say Start a pomodoro.
What you can download right now is a badge that looks a lot like a Focus Coin. If you already have a badge, tap it in the badge display frame to download.
If you already have a badge, tap it in the badge display frame to download.

entries.factKeyEn: Where is the idle-screen control that turns background music or ambient sound on or off?
entries.capabilityStatementEn: Where the idle-screen control turns background music or ambient sound on or off, and that it stays off until the person turns it on.
entries.shortAnswerEn: Tap the music control on the idle screen to turn background music on or off. It stays off until you turn it on. A sit may play music for that sit without switching this on for next time.

entries.factKeyEn: Is Honesty Check-in or a daily streak required, or can I sit with Yin without checking in?
entries.capabilityStatementEn: Whether check-in or a daily streak is required. Missing a day takes nothing away.
entries.shortAnswerEn: You do not have to check in. Sit with Yin works without it. Honesty Check-in, under More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice, only records quiet time you already did somewhere else. It is optional, and missing a day does not take anything away.

entries.factKeyEn: Can I ask Yin by voice to do things on this device instead of tapping, for example backing up my practice data?
entries.capabilityStatementEn: That Samatia is built so people who cannot tap comfortably can often speak instead; on the Mac desktop app Yin can listen for short English operating requests that run the same local actions as taps, with confirmation before writing files; words stay on this device.
entries.shortAnswerEn: When tapping is hard, Samatia is built so you can often speak instead. On the Mac desktop app, Yin can listen for short English requests that run the same local actions you would tap — for example starting a focus sit, ending with Rise, or backing up your practice data after Yin repeats what will happen and you say yes. Open More (⋯) or the drawer → Practice → Confide to Yin, or use Yin's listen entry when it is on screen. Example: Hi Yin, please backup all the app data for me. Your words stay on this device. More menu actions join over time. Yin only points here and does not read long scripts aloud.
On Idle, tap the left orb for Breath practice — a shorter sit with Yin, without opening the full Focus duration picker.

Breath practice on the left orb offers 1, 3, 5, 10, or 20 minutes. Twenty minutes is the longest Breath sitting.

A full Sit with Yin starts at 10 minutes and uses different chips (10 / 15 / 25 / 45). Breath practice is the shorter pause, not a second Focus session.
keywords: How long Breath practice can last

entries.shortAnswerEn:
Lotus blooms are quiet traces of time you have sat. They are not ranks, scores, or a character evolution track.

Open Where you are from the home journey line. Up to twelve blooms sit in a row between the next-step sentence and your lifetime minutes. The home seat no longer draws flowers in front of Yin.

There are two shelves.

Yin's Collections (fan Collection, or More → Yin's Collections) uses focus coins you earn by sitting. Those pieces cannot be bought with money.

Yin's Art Collection (More → Yin's Art Collection) is a separate paid art shelf. Choose a set, leave an email, and check out if you want the prints.

A badge may look like a Focus Coin, but it is a keepsake. You cannot spend a badge in Yin's Collections.

Focus coins are earned by sitting or breathing, and you spend those under Yin's Collections. If you already have a badge, tap it in the badge frame to download the picture.

Samatia runs in Safari on iPhone and iPad. There is no App Store or TestFlight app in this release — open the website in Safari. You can add it to your Home Screen for a full-screen shortcut.

Practice data stays on that device. The desktop app and another browser on the same account do not share the same local store.

A native iOS shell is not on the current roadmap; when that changes, we will say so here.

Samatia does not use Apple's system health SDK and does not read Apple Health. Journey Log on this device is separate local history — not Health data.

If you turn on the optional preference, a Log to Health button after a sit can open your Shortcuts app to run your installed mindful-minutes shortcut (you set it up once; permissions are between you and Apple, not a Samatia sign-in).

Supported path: iPhone or iPad, page opened in Safari — not WeChat or other in-app browsers. Mac has no Health app; the desktop app does not promise this button. The preference is off until you enable it.
